notes.title: Anniversary Sale
notes.content:
Has it already been a year since the game released? Wow. Anyway, the game is 60% to celebrate that specific milestone!

I hope you enjoyed the game, and I'm grateful to everyone who's played it. Any ideas you'd like to see in a sequel?

notes.title: 40% off Summer Sale!
notes.content:
It's the Steam Summer Sale! Load up that cart with incredible deals, and make sure Awakened Evil is one of them ;)

At an all time low of 40% off, don't miss this deal!

notes.title: 33% Off Sale
notes.content: Been holding out on fighting evil for a sweet discount? Well wait no more! The game and soundtrack are both 33% off this week!

notes.title: Update 1.2.2
notes.content:
Update 1.2.2

[/olist]

notes.title: Patch 1.2 Achievements added!
notes.content: The people have spoken, and they want achievements! Can you master the game and collect all 24?

notes.title: 25% off during the Steam Spring Sale!
notes.content: Spring is here (almost), so it's time to celebrate! Awakened Evil and the Soundtrack are both 25% off!!

notes.title: 1.1 Update
notes.content: This update is a few final things I wanted to get polished up. Expert mode now has a new ending and some extra surprises! I also added some art for the game over screen, and text when getting a 1up.

notes.title: Soundtrack now available!
notes.content: Feeling that chiptune music in the game? Well now you can listen to it all day long! Check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2279480/Awakened_Evil_Soundtrack/]soundtrack page[/url] and support our composer for just a few bucks!

notes.title: Join the Speedrun Community!
notes.content:
Beat the game, but looking for another challenge? Join the [url=https://www.speedrun.com/awakened_evil]Awakened Evil speedrun community[/url] and see if you can set a new world record! There's categories for full runs, and individual stages. There's already been some amazing runs, check them out below!

notes.title: Awakened Evil is out NOW!!
notes.content: The long wait is over, Awakened Evil is out today!! I hope you enjoy our little tribute to retro gaming :)

notes.title: Awakened Evil releases on January 30th!
notes.content: Evil has awakened and only you can stop it! It's been a long wait, but the game is finally releasing in less than a month. Clear your calendar, and battle evil on January, 30, 2023!!

notes.title: Another Developer Stream
notes.content: Miss out on the last developer stream? No worries, we're doing another! Join us this Sunday to hangout and ask questions while we play the demo.

notes.title: Developer Stream
notes.content:
Join us as we stream Awakened Evil for Steam Next Fest! Come hang out and feel free to ask us any questions you have about the game.

See you then!

notes.title: Demo is live for Steam Next Fest
notes.content: We're releasing a new demo for Steam Next Fest in February! Make sure you check it out and let us know what you think!
